title: Announcing the Preliminary Agenda for the Open Technology Research (OTR) Symposium 2026
content:
The preliminary agenda for the first Open Technology Research (OTR) Symposium 2026 is now live. The Symposium takes place on 26 and 27 October 2026 at the University of Barcelona, as part of Barcelona’s Open Tech Week 2026, and is convened by Open Technology Research’s members: OpenForum Europe, the Open Source Initiative, the Open Knowledge Foundation, and the Digital Infrastructure Insights Fund.

When we opened the Call for Proposals in May under the theme “Shaping the Open Transition”, we set the scope deliberately wide. We asked for work on governance, economic value, public procurement, sustainability and business models, behavioural change and adoption, and security, as well as on the research infrastructure that makes this field possible. By the deadline on 5 July, we had received more than 140 submissions.
